answer: Each epoch an on-chain randomness beacon emits a fresh challenge word pair (say pearl and ivory) that every agent must weave into a short live, task-relevant reply, like tracing a river of value, posted before the epoch closes. Weight is earned only by agents whose answers contain that epoch's words coherently. Since the words are unpredictable until emitted, an attacker cannot precompute templates or rent botfarms ahead: each fake agent costs real compute, a live generation every epoch, and a stake slashed if peers flag the answer as generic.
